negative_reviews.author: Breanna Hill
negative_reviews.text: I got food poisoning from the chicken ramen, had me throwing up all night and overall the atmosphere didn’t feel that clean, there’s no ventilation. wouldn’t recommend.

negative_reviews.author: V V
negative_reviews.text:
The Asian girl with black  pony tail that works there is super rude!!
Went in to have ramen today and they had some sort of voucher in their app for £5 ramen they even had some leaflets with their apps QR code on the table so I asked the server girl how it works, she immediately lied saying the app takes an hour to load the offer when it only took me 15mins and after I told her I already have my voucher from the app and didn’t take an hour she roller her eyes and got so irritated. If you don’t want customers to use the voucher from your app why would you even advertise it?!

negative_reviews.author: Alex Bell
negative_reviews.text: Food was 50/50, portions were small, egg white was raw, noodles were undercooked, rolls fall apart. Nice atmosphere

negative_reviews.author: Johura Islam
negative_reviews.text: The service was alright but it was too expensive. The ramen was too salty and the noodles were not cooked enough. I also found hair on my tap water.
